senses.gloss: वैतान- + कुशल वैतान- + कुशल, adj. Knowing the sacred ordinances, Man. 11, 37.

वैतंसिक वैतंसिक, i. e. वी̆तंस + इक, m. A vendor of the flesh of beasts or birds, Govardhana, Āryā Sapt. 154, b.
 --Comp.

वैतनिक वैतनिक, i. e. वेतन + इक, adj., f. की, sbst.
 1. Living on wages. []
 2. A hireling, a labourer.
 3. A stipendiary.

वैतानिक वैतानिक, i. e. वितान + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Performed with the three sacred fires, Man. 6, 9; 7, 78.
 2. Sacrificial, sacred, Śāk. 31, 11.
 II. n. Burnt offering, especially of clarified butter.

वैतरणि and णी वैतरणी, i. e. वितरण + ई, f.
 1. The river of hell, MBh. 18, 84 (णी).
 2. A proper name.

वैतस वैतस, i. e. वेतस + अ,
 I. adj., f. सी, Reed-like, Pañc. iii. d. 18.
 II. m. A sort of cane, Calamus fasciculatus.

वैतान वैतान, i. e. वितान + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Taken from the holy hearth, Śāk. d. 83.
 2. Sacrificial, sacred, Śāk. 43, 11, Chezy. (v. r.).
 II. n.
 1. Oblation with fire.
 2. The sacred ordinances, Man. 11, 37.

वैतालिक वैतालिक, m.
 I. i. e. विताल + इक, A bard, whose principal duty is to awaken a chief at dawn with music and song, a singer, Śāk. 62, 1; MBh. 1, 6940.
 II. i. e. वेताल + इक, One who has a Vetāla for a familiar.
वैतृष्ण्य वैतृष्ण्य, i. e. वि-तृष्ण (see तृष्णा), + य, n. Quenching of the thirst, Man. 5, 128.
